definitions.mse: mean squared error over all samples, frequency bins and real/imaginary coordinates
definitions.nmse: global squared-error sum divided by global target-energy sum; not mean per-window NMSE
definitions.non_dc: same metrics with the fftshift DC bin at index L//2 removed
definitions.masked_input_fft: orthonormal shifted FFT of the masked input without learned recovery
definitions.undefined_nmse: null when target energy is zero

mask.policy: fixed saved point masks; shared I/Q mask; True means masked
